issues.legal_issue: A tenant’s paid transfer of possession and tenancy rights to a third party is not a relinquishment of tenancy where the transaction is an assignment rather than a surrender to the landlord.
material_facts: The tenant handed vacant possession of the flat to a third party and received money that the prosecution treated as consideration for giving up the tenancy.
The written document stated that the tenant had no further claim over the flat and that the new occupant would pay rent directly to the landlord.
The arrangement was made with the new occupant; there was no mutual agreement with the landlord to surrender the tenancy.
The tenant was convicted for receiving consideration for relinquishment of a tenancy, and appealed that conviction.
issues.conclusion: The transaction was an assignment, not a relinquishment within the statutory meaning, so the conviction could not be sustained and was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 19(1) and 19(2) of the Bombay Rents, Hotel and Lodging House Rates Control Act, 1947, receiving consideration as a condition for relinquishing a tenancy is an offence. Relinquishment or surrender terminates the tenant’s rights and must be in favour of the lessor, by mutual agreement; an assignment transfers the tenant’s interest to another, while the assignor remains contractually liable to the landlord and the assignee becomes liable by privity of estate. Sections 15 and 18 distinguish tenant transfers from a landlord’s consent to a transfer for consideration, and section 108(i) of the Transfer of Property Act uses language concerning transfer of a tenant’s interest. Because the provision creates a criminal offence and imposes a penalty, it must be strictly construed in favour of the accused. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: criminal_appeal and penal_conviction_for_paid_tenancy_relinquishment and possession_transferred_to_third_party and (rent_payable_by_new_occupant or tenant_disclaimed_further_claim) and no_mutual_surrender_to_landlord

predicates.criminal_appeal: The matter is an appeal in a criminal proceeding.
predicates.penal_conviction_for_paid_tenancy_relinq: A tenant was convicted for receiving consideration in connection with giving up a tenancy.
predicates.possession_transferred_to_third_party: The tenant handed possession of the premises to someone other than the landlord or a person holding the landlord’s interest.
predicates.rent_payable_by_new_occupant: The arrangement provided for the new occupant to pay rent directly to the landlord.
predicates.tenant_disclaimed_further_claim: The tenant stated in the transfer arrangement that the tenant had no further claim over the premises.
predicates.no_mutual_surrender_to_landlord: The tenant and landlord did not mutually agree to terminate the tenancy by surrendering it to the landlord.

issues.definition: If a criminal appeal concerns a conviction for receiving consideration for giving up a tenancy, and possession was transferred to a third party under an arrangement with the stated features but without a mutual surrender to the landlord, the conviction is unsustainable.
